title: Apollo 11 Lands on the Moon
summary: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin touch down at Mare Tranquillitatis in Lunar Module 'Eagle'. The descent stage is left behind as humanity's first historic extraterrestrial monument.
significance: First humans to set foot on another world, proving safe crewed off-world landings and returning 21.6 kg of lunar material.

title: First Moon Buggy Deployed (Apollo 15 LRV)
summary: Dave Scott and Jim Irwin unfold the first Lunar Roving Vehicle, driving 27.8 km across Hadley Rille and discovering the 4.1-billion-year-old 'Genesis Rock'.
significance: Revolutionized lunar exploration by multiplying astronaut traverse distance tenfold beyond walking radius.

title: Apollo 17: Final Apollo Lunar Excursion
summary: Gene Cernan and scientist-astronaut Harrison Schmitt log 35.8 km in LRV-003, discovering orange pyroclastic volcanic glass in Taurus-Littrow. Cernan parks the rover to film the ascent stage launch.
significance: Marks the final human steps on the lunar surface of the 20th century. All three LRVs remain preserved on the Moon.

title: Viking 1 Touches Down on Mars
summary: Viking 1 executes the first successful American soft landing on Mars at Chryse Planitia, transmitting the first color panoramas of the red landscape.
significance: Conducted the first in-situ biology and organic chemistry tests on Martian soil and logged 2,245 sols of continuous weather data.

title: Voyager 1 Launches on the Grand Tour
summary: Voyager 1 blasts off from Cape Canaveral to explore Jupiter, Saturn, and Titan carrying the Golden Record—humanity's time capsule for extraterrestrial life.
significance: Discovered active volcanism on Io, complex ring mechanics at Saturn, and became the farthest human-made object in history.

title: Voyager 1 Captures the 'Pale Blue Dot'
summary: At the edge of the planetary zone (6 billion km from Earth), Voyager 1 turns its camera backwards for a family portrait of the solar system, photographing Earth as a solitary pixel in a sunbeam.
significance: Created an immortal symbol of human humility and planetary fragility, inspiring generations of environmental and space advocates.

title: Mars Pathfinder & Sojourner Land at Ares Vallis
summary: Mars Pathfinder touches down using giant airbags at Ares Vallis. Microrover Sojourner deploys to become the first mobile wheeled rover on Mars, analyzing rocks like 'Barnacle Bill'.
significance: Demonstrated low-cost interplanetary landing and mobile surface science, paving the way for the Spirit, Opportunity, and Curiosity rovers.

title: Spirit & Opportunity Twin Rovers Land on Mars
summary: NASA's Mars Exploration Rovers land at Gusev Crater and Meridiani Planum. Opportunity discovers hematite 'blueberries' confirming past standing liquid water.
significance: Opportunity operated for an astounding 14+ years (over 5,000 sols) until a planetary dust storm in 2018.

title: Voyager 1 Crosses into Interstellar Space
summary: Voyager 1 detects a sharp drop in solar particles and a fortyfold increase in galactic plasma, becoming the first human-made craft to cross the Heliopause.
significance: Humanity's first physical presence in interstellar space, directly measuring the cosmic radiation environment beyond the Sun's magnetic sphere.

title: Curiosity Rover Lands with Sky Crane in Gale Crater
summary: The one-ton Curiosity rover touches down via rocket-powered Sky Crane at Gale Crater, confirming ancient Mars had freshwater lakes capable of supporting microbial life.
significance: Pioneered nuclear-powered heavy planetary roving and advanced organic geochemistry on Mars.

title: New Horizons Flies Past Pluto
summary: NASA's New Horizons probe conducts the first flyby of Pluto and Charon, revealing towering water-ice mountains, glaciers of nitrogen ice, and a beating heart-shaped plain (Sputnik Planitia).
significance: Completed the initial reconnaissance of the classical solar system and continues outward into the Kuiper Belt.

title: Perseverance & Ingenuity Touch Down at Jezero Crater
summary: Perseverance lands in an ancient river delta to collect core samples for future Earth return. Accompanying drone Ingenuity achieves the first powered flight on another planet.
significance: Ingenuity completed 72 powered Martian atmospheric flights, opening the age of aerial exploration in planetary science.

title: Artemis I: Humanity Prepares to Return to the Moon
summary: The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket propels the uncrewed Orion spacecraft into a distant retrograde lunar orbit, validating deep-space heat shields and navigation.
significance: The inaugural test of NASA's Artemis program, targeting sustainable long-term human presence and lunar surface bases.
